ForcemanagerSessionKeyCredential.title: ForceManager Session Key
ForcemanagerSessionKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste an existing session token from the ForceManager v4 POST /login response. Obtain it with your public API key as username and private API key as password; an admin finds these under Settings > Integrations > API key. NoClick sends the token as X-Session-Key to the production API. If it expires, obtain a new token and replace it here.
